m1.mp3: I worked in the same plant for 31 years and I hated most of it. But I never let a Sunday go by without the family, and my brother and I spoke every week until he died. I am 86 and I still walk to the shops.
m2.mp3: I made money early, and I made a great deal of it. I was in the office six days a week for most of my forties. My marriage was cold for a long time and I told myself it did not matter. I am 84 and there is nobody in the house.
m3.mp3: People assume the Harvard men did better. They did not, on the whole. What separated the two files was not where they started. It was who they still had at 50.
m4.mp3: They studied him for 40 years before anybody thought to ask me anything. When they finally did, I said it was about time.
